name: Relic Bakery & Kitchen
notes: 4 photos of the same printed trifold/flat menu, taken on different visits with rotating lunch specials (Mary's Chicken Roulade in photo 2; Sesame Crusted Avocado + Seared Rockfish in photo 3; Organic Black Garlic Ceasar in photo 4) and small price drift on the shared items across photos. Used photo 1 as the base pricing for items common to all photos and added each unique rotating special once at its own listed price. The wine list was skipped as a drink-only section.

dishes.name: French Omlette Croissant
dishes.description: Tri-fold omlette with farm fresh eggs, housemaid roasted poblano hash brown, sharp cheddar, Girl & Dug Farm red sorrel, all on our delicious croissant.

dishes.name: Sausage Egg & Cheese English Muffin
dishes.description: House-made maple breakfast pork sausage, over-easy egg from Hilliker Farms, J.R. Organics Arugula, caramelized onions, and american cheese on our sourdough English muffin.

dishes.name: Pumpkin Bread Pudding
dishes.description: Made from house-made croissants with pomegranate, pears, Fromage Blanc, and pumpkin créme anglaise.

dishes.name: Mary's Chicken Roulade
dishes.description: 5 oz of Mary's Chicken, stuffed with a chicken mousseline, served with golden thread mushrooms, Swiss chard, butter poached pearl onions, Parmesan crisps & glossy red wine chicken demi.

dishes.name: Sesame Crusted Avocado
dishes.description: Avocados from Polito Family Farms, topped with black and white sesame seeds and seared. Pickled Sungold Tomatoes, mustard lettuce, and baby crookneck squash, and muchim brine.

dishes.name: JR Organics Salad
dishes.description: Lettuce spring mix, watermelon radish, lightly salted cucumbers, blue lake green beans, pickled red onion, champagne vinaigrette, Parmesan, and toasted Marcona almonds.

dishes.name: Organic Black Garlic Ceasar
dishes.description: J.R. Organics romaine lettuce, traditional ceasar dressing, black garlic powder, organic celery leaves, bread crumbs, & parmeson.

dishes.name: House Roasted Turkey Sandwich
dishes.description: House brined & roasted turkey, grilled with melty Swiss cheese, piccalilli, dijonaise, shaved romaine lettuce from JR Organics, on our brioche roll.

dishes.name: Chicken Curry Salad Sandwich
dishes.description: Shredded Mary's chicken, madras curry, cashews, golden raisins, pickled red onion, JR Organics greens, on our grilled sourdough.

dishes.name: Seared Rockfish w/ Bouillabaisse Sauce
dishes.description: Line caught Vermilion Rockfish seared with broccolini, turnips, fennel frawns, crispy turnip leaves, and gold flakes, placed on top of an organic, clam based, bouillabaisse sauce.
